description: Targeted held-out set for self-cued phrases (let me tweak/change/..., model what happens, boxes and arrows, 바꿔가며, 조절하면서, 움직이는 모습으로, ...), written before adding context checks to them. 'paraphrase' cases use a phrase as a real output request; 'collision' cases use the same phrase in a non-request sense. Same labeling rules as v0.1/v0.2. Do not tune rules against this file.
